adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~10–30 MAD drop in all axes between J2 (~488) and J3 (~524), with clear return near J3. P1 (476–518) starts too early and ends before full recovery; P2 (484–523) better aligns with onset (J2) and return (J3), but end at 523 slightly precedes the visible U-axis recovery at ~524. Hypothesis P2 subtraction yields flat residuals across all axes through the interval, confirming a genuine temporary platform. No other persistent offsets or motion contradict this. Thus only P2 is a genuine temporary platform; P1 is subsumed/invalid.
